exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 13 — Time Will Tell!
exercises.instructionUz: 13-UNIT — Vaqt ko'rsatadi!
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'Time will tell!' — turg'un ibora.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Vaqt aytadi.'
  Ma'nosi: kelajakda nima bo'lishini hozir hech kim
  bilmaydi — buni faqat VAQT ko'rsatadi.

  DIQQAT: iborada 'WILL' bor — bu unitning
  asosiy grammatikasiga ishora.


UNIT 13 NING ASOSIY MAVZULARI
(4-modul muqovasidan):
  • future plans / intentions / predictions
    (kelajak rejalari / niyatlar / bashoratlar)
  • horoscopes
    (munajjimlar bashorati)


GRAMMATIKASI — UCh XIL KELAJAK:

  BE GOING TO   →  REJA va NIYAT
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel.'
     Bu bet aynan shu shaklga bag'ishlangan.

  WILL          →  TAXMIN
     'I think it will rain.'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  REJALAShTIRILGAN uchrashuv
     'Jenny IS HAVING a party on 16th August.'
     (2-mashqda shu shakl so'raladi)


BETDAGI SARLAVHA RASMI:
  'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy — Jennining rejalaridan
  biri: uyini SOTISh (9-band).
  Bu rasm 4-modul muqovasida ham bor edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  fabulous     = ajoyib, zo'r
  to relax     = dam olmoq
  to windsurf  = vindserfing bilan shug'ullanmoq
  to sunbathe  = quyoshda toblanmoq
  ballet       = balet
  to join a gym = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq
  a course     = kurs

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N MAShG'ULOT:
   1  stay at a fabulous hotel  (ajoyib mehmonxonada
                                turmoq)
   2  relax                     (dam olmoq)
   3  start windsurfing         (vindserfingni
                                boshlamoq)
   4  sunbathe                  (quyoshda toblanmoq)
   5  take ballet lessons       (balet darslariga
                                bormoq)
   6  work at a cafe            (kafeda ishlamoq)
   7  start French lessons      (fransuz tili
                                darslarini boshlamoq)
   8  join a gym                (sport zaliga a'zo
                                bo'lmoq)
   9  sell her house            (uyini sotmoq)
  10  start a computer course   (kompyuter kursini
                                boshlamoq)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  A  →   9   sell her house
         (rasmda: 'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy)

  B  →   7   start French lessons
         (rasmda: sinf xonasi, doska oldida
          o'qituvchi, partalarda o'quvchilar)

  C  →  10   start a computer course
         (rasmda: kostyumdagi erkak va kompyuter
          monitori)

  D  →   2   relax
         (rasm 93-BETNING chap yuqorisida:
          gamakda yotib kitob o'qiyotgan ayol)

  E  →   5   take ballet lessons
         (rasmda: baletchi qiz stanok yonida,
          yonida o'qituvchi)

  F  →   3   start windsurfing
         (rasmda: dengizda vindserfing yelkani
          bilan qiz)

  G  →   1   stay at a fabulous hotel
         (rasmda: plyaj yonidagi katta mehmonxona)

  H  →   6   work at a cafe
         (rasmda: ofitsiant qiz podnosda ichimlik
          olib kelmoqda)

  I  →   4   sunbathe
         (rasmda: ko'zoynakli ayol dengiz bo'yida
          shezlongda yotibdi)

  J  →   8   join a gym
         (rasmda: sport zali, mashg'ulot
          uskunalari, odamlar)


DIQQAT — 'D' RASMI QAYERDA:
  'D' rasmi bu betda emas, 93-BETNING chap
  yuqorisida joylashgan — gamakda yotib kitob
  o'qiyotgan ayol.
  Bu aynan 'RELAX' (2-band): 93-betdagi xatda
  Jenni 'I'm going to RELAX as much as possible'
  deb yozgan.


'I' RASMI HAQIDA — NEGA 'SUNBATHE', 'RELAX' EMAS:
  Rasmda ayol DENGIZ BO'YIDA, quyosh ostida,
  ko'zoynak taqib yotibdi → bu aynan
  'to SUNBATHE' (quyoshda toblanmoq).
  'relax' esa umumiyroq — dam olishning har qanday
  turi.
  Kitob bu ikkisini ATAYLAB yonma-yon bergan,
  chunki ular o'xshash, lekin bir xil emas.


MAShG'ULOTLARNING IKKI GURUHI:

  TA'TIL bilan bog'liq (mehmonxonada):
     1 stay at a fabulous hotel
     2 relax
     3 start windsurfing
     4 sunbathe

  TA'TILDAN KEYIN (uyda, yoz davomida):
     5 take ballet lessons
     6 work at a cafe
     7 start French lessons
     8 join a gym
     9 sell her house
    10 start a computer course


DIQQAT — FE'L BIRIKMALARI:
  'STAY AT a hotel'      (predlog AT)
  'WORK AT a cafe'       (predlog AT)
  'START windsurfing'    (start + -ING)
  'START French lessons' (start + OT)
  'TAKE lessons'         (dars olmoq)
  'JOIN a gym'           (a'zo bo'lmoq)

exercises.instructionEn: Jenny sent a letter to her friend, Sarah. Listen to Sarah reading Jenny's letter and tick what Jenny is going to do and put a cross next to what she isn't going to do. Then, look at the list and make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Jenni do'sti Saraga xat yubordi. Sara Jennining xatini o'qiganini tinglang va Jenni QILMOQCHI bo'lgan ishlarga ✓, QILMOQCHI EMAS ishlarga ✗ qo'ying. So'ng ro'yxatga qarab namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  ✓ 1-band:
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel.'

  ✗ 4-band:
     'Jenny ISN'T GOING TO sunbathe.'


QOLIP — 'BE GOING TO':

  TASDIQ:
     ega + AM / IS / ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay ...'

  INKOR:
     ega + ISN'T / AREN'T + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l
     'Jenny ISN'T GOING TO sunbathe.'
     DIQQAT: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN qo'yiladi
     ('is not going to' → 'isn't going to').

  SO'ROQ:
     AM / IS / ARE + ega + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l?
     'IS Jenny GOING TO relax?'


DIQQAT — 'GOING TO' DAN KEYIN ASOSIY ShAKL:
     'going to STAY'      ✓
     'going to staying'   ✗
     'going to stays'     ✗
     'going to to stay'   ✗


DIQQAT — 'BE GOING TO' NIMANI BILDIRADI:
  Oldindan O'YLANGAN REJA yoki NIYAT.
  Jenni bu ishlarni allaqachon HAL QILGAN.

  'will' esa shu payt qabul qilingan qaror yoki
  taxmin uchun ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (93-betdagi xatdan tasdiqlangan):

   1  stay at a fabulous hotel   ✓  (kitob bergan)
   2  relax                      ✓
   3  start windsurfing          ✗
   4  sunbathe                   ✗  (kitob bergan)
   5  take ballet lessons        ✗
   6  work at a cafe             ✓
   7  start French lessons       ✗
   8  join a gym                 ✓
   9  sell her house             ✗
  10  start a computer course    ✓

  ✓ — BESHTA:  1, 2, 6, 8, 10
  ✗ — BESHTA:  3, 4, 5, 7, 9

QOIDA: xatda AYTILGAN ish → ✓, AYTILMAGAN → ✗.
Har birining asosi 93-betdagi 1b-javoblar
bo'limida ko'rsatilgan.

DIQQAT — 9-BAND ALDAMChI: unit sarlavhasida
'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy rasmi bor, lekin xatda uy
sotish haqida bir so'z ham yo'q — Jenni aksincha
MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI ('buy a new car').

exercises.instructionEn: Listen again and say what Jenny is doing on 1st June, 30th June and 16th August.
exercises.instructionUz: Yana tinglang va Jenni 1-iyun, 30-iyun va 16-avgustda nima qilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MAShQ BOShQA GRAMMATIKANI SO'RAYDI:

  1b-mashqda:  BE GOING TO  (umumiy REJA)
  2-mashqda:   PRESENT CONTINUOUS
               (ANIQ SANAGA belgilangan ish)


QOIDA — QAChON PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Agar ish ANIQ VAQTGA belgilangan bo'lsa
  (kun, sana, soat) — PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  ishlatiladi:

     'Jenny IS LEAVING on 1st June.'
     'She IS COMING BACK on 30th June.'
     'She IS HAVING a party on 16th August.'

  Bu — 4-modul muqovasidagi
  'Present continuous (future meaning)'.


QOLIP:
  ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING + ON + sana

  DIQQAT: SANA bilan 'ON' predlogi
  (3-modul testi, 90-bet, 3-mashqning qoidasi).


JAVOBLAR 93-BETDAGI XATDAN OLINADI:
  Jennining xati aynan shu uchta sanani
  eslatadi. Xat 93-betda to'liq bosilgan,
  shuning uchun audio SHART EMAS.

  Uch sana:
     1st June    — ta'tilning boshlanishi
     30th June   — ta'tilning tugashi
     16th August — tug'ilgan kun ziyofati
       (3-mashqning 4-savoli buni tasdiqlaydi:
        'When is Jenny having a party? Why?')


DIQQAT — 'BE GOING TO' va PRESENT CONTINUOUS
FARQI:

  'Jenny IS GOING TO relax.'
     → umumiy NIYAT, aniq vaqt yo'q

  'Jenny IS LEAVING on 1st June.'
     → ANIQ sanaga belgilangan, hamma narsa
       tayyor (chipta olingan)

  Ikkalasi ham KELAJAK haqida, lekin
  aniqlik darajasi boshqa.

exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  computer, great, go, earn, work, join, lose,
  fabulous

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  GREAT news          (ajoyib yangilik)
  2  to GO on holiday    (ta'tilga bormoq)
  3  a FABULOUS hotel    (ajoyib mehmonxona)
  4  to WORK hard        (qattiq ishlamoq)
  5  to EARN money       (pul topmoq)
  6  to JOIN a gym       (sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq)
  7  to LOSE weight      (vazn tashlamoq)
  8  a COMPUTER course   (kompyuter kursi)


HAMMASI JENNINING XATIDAN:
  1  'I've got some GREAT NEWS.'
  2  'we are GOING ON HOLIDAY for a whole month'
  3  'a FABULOUS HOTEL right next to the beach'
  4  'after WORKING HARD all this year'
  5  'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'
  6  'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'
  7  'to LOSE some WEIGHT'
  8  'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'


QANDAY ANIQLASh — SO'Z TURIGA QARANG:

  'TO' bor (2, 4, 5, 6, 7) → FE'L kerak:
     go, work, earn, join, lose

  'A' bor (3, 8) → OT yoki SIFAT kerak:
     a FABULOUS hotel (sifat)
     a COMPUTER course (ot, sifat vazifasida)

  Artiklsiz (1) → SIFAT:
     GREAT news
     ('news' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' YO'Q)


ENG MUHIM BIRIKMALAR — YODLASh KERAK:

  to EARN money   =  pul topmoq (mehnat bilan)
     DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuqda, sovrinda.
             'to earn' — ishlab topish.

  to LOSE weight  =  vazn tashlamoq
     Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
     DIQQAT: 'to lose' — yo'qotmoq.

  to JOIN a gym   =  sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ
     DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq.

  to WORK hard    =  qattiq ishlamoq
     DIQQAT: 'hardly' — BUTUNLAY boshqa so'z
     ('deyarli emas')! 'work hardly' XATO.

  to GO on holiday =  ta'tilga bormoq
     Predlog ON.


DIQQAT — 1 va 3-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM 'AJOYIB':
     GREAT news      — 'great' = ajoyib, zo'r
     FABULOUS hotel  — 'fabulous' = ajoyib, zo'r
  Ma'nolari yaqin, lekin kitob har birini AYNAN
  xatdagi joyida ishlatishni so'raydi.

tasks.answer: earn
tasks.whyUz:
'to EARN money' = pul topmoq (mehnat bilan).
Xatda: 'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'.
DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuq, sovrin uchun.
'to earn' — ishlab topish.

tasks.answer: join
tasks.whyUz:
'to JOIN a gym' = sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ.
Xatda: 'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'.
DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq;

tasks.answer: lose
tasks.whyUz:
'to LOSE weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
Xatda: 'to LOSE some WEIGHT'.
Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
lose → LOST (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.answer: computer
tasks.whyUz:
'a COMPUTER course' = kompyuter kursi.
Xatda: 'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'.
DIQQAT: 'computer' — OT, lekin bu yerda SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI
('computers course' XATO).

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SAVOL. Jennining XATI 93-BETDA
bosilgan — javoblar o'sha yerdan olinadi.

SAVOLLAR:

  1  Where is Jenny going to spend her summer
     holiday?
     (Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?)

  2  What is Jenny going to do during her holiday?
     (Jenni ta'til davomida nima qilmoqchi?)

  3  What are Jenny's plans for the rest of the
     summer?
     (Jennining yozning qolgan qismiga rejalari
      qanday?)

  4  When is Jenny having a party? Why?
     (Jenni qachon ziyofat qiladi? Nega?)


SAVOLLARNING TUZILIShI — DIQQAT:

  1, 2-savollar:  'is going to' →
                  javob ham 'is going to' bilan
  3-savol:        'plans' →
                  javob rejalar ro'yxati
  4-savol:        'is having' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                  (aniq sanaga belgilangan)


JAVOB QOLIPLARI:

  1  'She is going to spend her summer holiday
      in/at ... .'

  2  'She is going to ... and ... .'
     (1b-mashqdagi ✓ belgilangan bandlar)

  3  'She is going to ... .'
     (ta'tildan keyingi rejalar: 5-10 bandlar)

  4  'She is having a party on 16th August
      because ... .'
     'because' bilan SABAB ko'rsatiladi.


DIQQAT — SAVOLDAGI ZAMONNI JAVOBDA SAQLANG:
  Savol: 'What IS Jenny GOING TO do ...?'
  Javob: 'She IS GOING TO ...'

  Savol: 'When IS Jenny HAVING a party?'
  Javob: 'She IS HAVING a party on ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to spend a holiday = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq
  during             = ... davomida
  the rest of        = ... ning qolgan qismi
  to have a party    = ziyofat qilmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Jenny's letter to Sarah
exercises.instructionUz: Jennining Saraga yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

                              6 Greenway Road
                              Wethersham
                              6 May, ...

  Dear Sarah,

  I've got some great news. Richard and I are going
  on holiday for a whole month. Guess where —
  Hawaii!

  We're leaving on 1st June. We both love swimming,
  so we're going to stay at a fabulous hotel right
  next to the beach. I'm going to relax as much as
  possible because I'm quite tired after working
  hard all this year.

  We're coming back from our holidays on 30th June,
  and I've got lots of plans for the rest of the
  summer. First, I'm going to work at a cafe
  because I want to earn some extra money and buy a
  new car. I'm also going to join a gym to lose
  some weight. Finally, I want to find a better job
  in autumn, so I'm going to start a computer
  course.

  Oh, I nearly forgot! On 16th August we're having
  a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
  Please try to come. You're welcome to spend the
  night here.

  Well, that's all for now. Hope to see you soon.

                              Love,
                              Jenny


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

                              6 Grinvey ko'chasi
                              Vetersham
                              6-may, ...

  Hurmatli Sara,

  Menda ajoyib yangilik bor. Richard bilan men
  butun bir oyga ta'tilga ketyapmiz. Qayerga
  ekanini top-chi — Gavayiga!

  Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz. Ikkalamiz ham suzishni
  yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun plyajning
  yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchimiz.
  Men imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchiman, chunki
  butun yil qattiq ishlaganimdan keyin ancha
  charchaganman.

  Biz ta'tildan 30-iyunda qaytamiz va yozning
  qolgan qismiga ko'plab rejalarim bor. Avvalo,
  kafeda ishlamoqchiman, chunki bir oz qo'shimcha
  pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.
  Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport
  zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman. Nihoyat, kuzda
  yaxshiroq ish topmoqchiman, shuning uchun
  kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.

  Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 16-avgustda
  Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun
  bog'da ziyofat qilamiz. Iltimos, kelishga
  harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang ham
  mayli.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishguncha.

                              Mehr bilan,
                              Jenni


XAT QOLIPI (rasmiy bo'lmagan xat):
  O'ng yuqorida:  MANZIL va SANA
  Boshi:          'Dear Sarah,'
  Oxiri:          'Love, Jenny'
  DIQQAT: 'Love,' — yaqin do'stga yoziladi.


XATDAGI IKKI XIL KELAJAK — ENG MUHIM:

  BE GOING TO  →  REJA va NIYAT
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS  →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... on 30th June.'
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party.'

  NAQSh: PRESENT CONTINUOUS ishlatilgan uchala
  gapda ham ANIQ SANA bor!
  'be going to' li gaplarda esa sana YO'Q.
  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining
  aynan qoidasi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a whole month  = butun bir oy
  Guess where!   = Qayerda ekanini top-chi!
  Hawaii         = Gavayi (AQSh shtati, orollar)
  right next to  = yonginasida
  as much as possible = imkon qadar ko'proq
  extra money    = qo'shimcha pul
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  autumn         = kuz
  I nearly forgot = sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim
  a garden party = bog'dagi ziyofat
  to celebrate   = nishonlamoq
  You're welcome to ... = ... bo'lsangiz mayli
  to spend the night = tunab qolmoq
  that's all for now = hozircha shu

exercises.instructionUz: 92-betdagi 2-mashqning javoblari: Jenni 1-iyun, 30-iyun va 16-avgustda nima qiladi
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SANA — HAMMASI XATDAN.

  1st JUNE:
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     → Jenny is leaving (for Hawaii) on 1st June.
     (Jenni 1-iyunda Gavayiga jo'nab ketadi.)

  30th JUNE:
     'We're COMING BACK from our holidays on 30th
      June.'
     → Jenny is coming back from her holidays on
       30th June.
     (Jenni 30-iyunda ta'tildan qaytadi.)

  16th AUGUST:
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party to
      celebrate Richard's birthday.'
     → Jenny is having a garden party on 16th
       August (to celebrate Richard's birthday).
     (Jenni 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan
      kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat
      qiladi.)


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Xatda PRESENT CONTINUOUS aynan SHU UChTA gapda
  ishlatilgan — va uchalasida ham ANIQ SANA bor!

  Qolgan hamma rejalar 'BE GOING TO' bilan
  berilgan va ularda SANA YO'Q.

  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining qoidasi:
     'be going to'        →  reja va niyat
     'present continuous' →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN
                             reja (fixed arrangement)


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:
  Chipta olingan, joy band qilingan, sana
  belgilangan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
  Faqat niyat qilingan, hali aniq emas →
  BE GOING TO.

  Jennining ta'tili ANIQ (chipta bor) → 'we're
  leaving'.
  Kafedagi ish esa hali REJA → 'I'm going to
  work'.

ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK KUZATUV:
  HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan yozilgan —
  chunki bular BAShORAT (predictions), dalilga
  asoslanmagan (95-betdagi qoida).

  Uchraydigan shakllar:
     'This WILL BE ...'      (tasdiq)
     'You'LL get ...'        (qisqargan: you will)
     'This WON'T be ...'     (inkor: will not)
     'THERE WILL BE bad news' (there will be + OT)
     'IT WILL BE a pleasant week' (it will be)

  Va BUYRUQ gaplar:
     'ACCEPT it.'    'DON'T ACCEPT it.'
     'DON'T WORRY.'  'TRY to relax.'
     'ENJOY yourself.'

  'It WILL BE a pleasant week' — 'pleasant' SIFAT

  'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT
     → THERE will be
  Bitta istisno ham yo'q.

tasks.uz: EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun): Bu qiyin hafta bo'ladi. Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
tasks.note:
QALIN: argue with.

DIQQAT: predlog WITH.

tasks.en: CANCER (June 22 - July 22): You'll go on a long journey this week. You'll enjoy yourself a lot, but don't drive too fast.
tasks.uz: QISQICHBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul): Bu hafta uzoq safarga chiqasan. Juda zavqlanasan, lekin tez haydama.
tasks.note:
QALIN: journey.
'a journey' = safar (uzoq).
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
'enjoy YOURSELF' — o'zlik olmoshi.

tasks.en: LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23): You'll get some good news in a letter, and you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.
tasks.uz: ARSLON (23-iyul — 23-avg): Xatda yaxshi yangilik olasan va shanba kuni juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
tasks.note:
QALIN: news, have a lot of fun.

'have fun' = ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazmoq.

tasks.en: VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23): You'll have problems with someone in your family. Don't worry — everything will be okay soon.
tasks.uz: PARIZOD (24-avg — 23-sent): Oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Xavotir olma — tez orada hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'have problems WITH sb' — predlog WITH.
'everything' — BIRLIK → 'will be'.

tasks.en: LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23): This will be a pleasant week. You'll go on a short trip and you'll have lots of fun.
tasks.uz: TAROZI (24-sent — 23-okt): Bu yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qisqa sayohatga chiqasan va juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
tasks.note:
QALIN: pleasant, trip.
'pleasant' = yoqimli.
'a trip' = qisqa sayohat ('a journey' — uzoq).
'lots of fun' = 'a lot of fun'.

tasks.en: SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22): You will lose some money on Tuesday. A friend will bring you some good news. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Don't accept it.
tasks.uz: CHAYON (24-okt — 22-noy): Seshanba kuni bir oz pul yo'qotasan. Do'sting senga yaxshi yangilik keltiradi. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qilma.
tasks.note:
'lose money' = pul yo'qotmoq.
DIQQAT: Taurus va Aquarius 'ACCEPT it' deydi,
Scorpio esa 'DON'T ACCEPT it' — TESKARI.

tasks.en: SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21): This will be a horrible week. There will be bad news on Wednesday and you'll have problems with someone in your family. The weekend will be better.
tasks.uz: YOY (23-noy — 21-dek): Bu dahshatli hafta bo'ladi. Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi va oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN: horrible.

'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT → THERE.
'BETTER' — 'good' ning qiyosiy shakli.

tasks.en: CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20): This won't be a good week for you. You'll have problems with your health. Try to relax.
tasks.uz: ECHKI (22-dek — 20-yanv): Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olishga harakat qil.
tasks.note:
QALIN: health.
'won't' = 'will not' — INKOR.
'health' = sog'liq (SANALMAYDIGAN).
'try TO relax' — 'try to + fe'l'.

tasks.en: AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18): This will be your lucky week. You will get a lot of money. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Accept it.
tasks.uz: QOVGA (21-yanv — 18-fev): Bu sening omadli hafting bo'ladi. Ko'p pul olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil.
tasks.note:
QALIN: lucky.
'lucky' = omadli.
Yagona bashorat 'a lot of MONEY' haqida —
12b-mashqning 4-savoli uchun.

tasks.en: PISCES (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20): This will be a bad week. You will have problems with your health. Try to rest during the weekend. Things will be better next week.
tasks.uz: BALIQLAR (19-fev — 20-mart): Bu yomon hafta bo'ladi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari dam olishga harakat qil. Keyingi hafta hammasi yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'health' — Capricorn bilan bir xil mavzu
(12b-mashqning 3-savoli).
'during' = ... davomida.
'next week' — 'the' YO'Q.

tasks.en: ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19): It will be a pleasant week for you. You'll meet an interesting person and you'll get a lot of invitations. Enjoy yourself.
tasks.uz: QO'Y (21-mart — 19-apr): Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qiziqarli odam bilan uchrashasan va ko'plab takliflar olasan. Zavqlan.

→ IT (95-betdagi qoida).
'invitationS' — KO'PLIK (12b, 2-savol).
'Enjoy yourself' — buyruq + o'zlik olmoshi.

exercises.instructionEn: Which month were you born in? What is your star sign? Read the sentences, then listen to Madame Annette and write T (for true) or F (for false).
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi oyda tug'ilgansiz? Burjingiz qaysi? Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng Madam Annetni tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — HAR BIRI BITTA BURJ HAQIDA.

DIQQAT — AUDIO KERAK EMAS:
  Oltala javob ham shu betdagi BOSILGAN
  bashoratlardan so'zma-so'z tekshiriladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Taurus: This will be a difficult week.   F
  2  Cancer: You'll go on a short journey.    F
  3  Leo: You'll get some good news in a
     letter.                                 T
  4  Libra: This will be a bad week.          F
  5  Capricorn: This won't be a good week
     for you.                                T
  6  Aquarius: This will be your lucky week.  T

  T — UCHTA:  3, 5, 6
  F — UCHTA:  1, 2, 4


HAR BIRI QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  1  Gap: 'This will be a DIFFICULT week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be an EXCITING week.'
     → F. ('difficult' — bu GEMINI ning so'zi!)

  2  Gap: 'You'll go on a SHORT journey.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll go on a LONG journey.'
     → F. ('short' — bu LIBRA ning so'zi!)

  3  Gap: 'You'll get some good news in a letter.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll get some good news in a
     letter.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  4  Gap: 'This will be a BAD week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
     → F. ('bad' — bu PISCES ning so'zi!)

  5  Gap: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     Bashorat: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  6  Gap: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.


NAQSh — KITOB QANDAY ALDAYDI:
  Uchala 'F' bandida kitob BOShQA burjning
  so'zini olib qo'ygan:
     'difficult' — aslida Gemini niki
     'short'     — aslida Libra niki
     'bad'       — aslida Pisces niki

  Uchala 'T' bandida esa so'zma-so'z ko'chirilgan.

  Ya'ni: gapdagi SIFATNI bashoratdagi sifat bilan
  solishtirish yetarli.


BURJINGIZNI ANIQLASh:
  Tug'ilgan oyingiz va kuningizga qarab
  yuqoridagi sanalar ro'yxatidan toping.
  Masalan: 15-avgust → LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a star sign = burj
  a horoscope = munajjimlar bashorati
  Madame     = xonim (fransuzcha murojaat)

exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL: 'Which horoscope says ...?'
(Qaysi bashoratda shunday deyilgan?)

DIQQAT — KITOB OGOHLANTIRADI:
  'For some questions, there is MORE THAN ONE
   correct answer.'
  Ya'ni ba'zi savollarda BIR NEChTA javob bor.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  you'll receive a letter from a friend?
     →  TAURUS                       (kitob bergan)

  2  you'll get an invitation/invitations?
     →  TAURUS, SCORPIO, AQUARIUS, ARIES  (TO'RTTA)

  3  you'll have health problems?
     →  CAPRICORN, PISCES                 (IKKITA)

  4  you'll get a lot of money?
     →  AQUARIUS                          (BITTA)

  5  you'll have problems with someone in your
     family?
     →  VIRGO, SAGITTARIUS                (IKKITA)


HAR BIRI QAYERDAN:

  1  TAURUS: 'You'll RECEIVE A LETTER FROM A
     FRIEND.'
     DIQQAT: Leo da ham xat bor, lekin u
     'get some good news IN A LETTER' —
     do'stdan xat OLISh emas.
     Scorpio da esa 'A FRIEND will BRING you some
     good news' — xat emas.

  2  TAURUS:   'you'll get a special INVITATION'
     SCORPIO:  'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     AQUARIUS: 'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     ARIES:    'you'll get a lot of INVITATIONS'
     → TO'RTTA bashorat.
     DIQQAT: savolda 'invitation/invitationS' —
     kitob ataylab ikkala shaklni bergan, chunki
     Aries da KO'PLIK.

  3  CAPRICORN: 'You'll have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     PISCES:    'You will have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, deyarli bir xil so'zlar.

  4  AQUARIUS: 'You will get A LOT OF MONEY.'
     → FAQAT BITTA.
     DIQQAT: Scorpio da pul bor, lekin
     'You will LOSE some money' — YO'QOTASAN,
     olmaysan. Bu TESKARI.

  5  VIRGO:       'You'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     SAGITTARIUS: 'you'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, so'zma-so'z bir xil.


ENG ALDAMChI NUQTALAR:

  1-SAVOL: Uchta bashoratda 'letter' yoki 'friend'
     bor, lekin faqat TAURUS da 'do'stdan XAT
     OLISh' bor.

  4-SAVOL: Scorpio da ham 'money' bor, lekin
     'LOSE money' (yo'qotmoq) — savolda esa 'GET
     money' (olmoq). TESKARI ma'no.


DIQQAT — TAKLIF QABUL QILISh:
  Uchta bashorat taklif haqida gapiradi, lekin
  maslahat HAR XIL:
     TAURUS:   'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     AQUARIUS: 'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     SCORPIO:  'DON'T ACCEPT it.'  (qabul qilma)
  Bu — 4-modulda o'rganiladigan 'accept/refuse
  invitations' ko'nikmasiga tayyorgarlik.

exercises.instructionUz: Rejalar va niyatlarni ifodalash
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO move house?         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.

  TASDIQ:  ega + AM/IS/ARE + going to + fe'l
  INKOR:   ega + AM/IS/ARE + NOT + going to + fe'l
  SO'ROQ:  AM/IS/ARE + ega + going to + fe'l?


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'NOT' QAYERDA:
  'be' fe'lidan KEYIN:
     I AM NOT going to ...   → I'M NOT going to ...
     You ARE NOT going to ... → You AREN'T going to ...
     He IS NOT going to ...  → He ISN'T going to ...

  'I don't going to' XATO —
  'do/does' KERAK EMAS.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'BE' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Are you going to move house?'  ✓
     'Do you going to move house?'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to move house?'
     'Yes, I AM.'          ✓
     'Yes, I am going to.' — to'liq, lekin qisqa
                             javob emas


'MOVE HOUSE' NIMA:
  'to move house' = boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoq.
  DIQQAT: 'house' oldidan artikl YO'Q —
  bu turg'un ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: be going to - present continuous
exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKINChI QUTI:

  'We use BE GOING TO to talk about FUTURE PLANS
   AND INTENTIONS. We use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS
   to talk about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

  = 'be going to' ni KELAJAK REJALARI va
    NIYATLARI haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
    'present continuous' ni esa QAT'IY
    BELGILANGAN kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish
    uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM VA GAP:

  CHAP RASM — plans/intentions (BE GOING TO)
     Yigit qizga gapiryapti:
     'I'M GOING TO fly to Poland SOON.'
     (Yaqinda Polshaga uchmoqchiman.)
     → 'soon' = yaqinda — ANIQ vaqt YO'Q.
       Hali chipta olinmagan, faqat NIYAT.

  O'NG RASM — fixed arrangements
               (PRESENT CONTINUOUS)
     Yigit qo'lida ChIPTA ushlab turibdi:
     'I'M FLYING to Poland AT 7 O'CLOCK.'
     (Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.)
     → 'at 7 o'clock' = ANIQ vaqt.
       Chipta olingan, hamma narsa TAYYOR.

  DIQQAT: rasmda yigitning qo'lida ChIPTA bor —
  kitob shu bilan farqni KO'RSATMOQDA.


ENG SODDA QOIDA:

     ANIQ VAQT (sana, soat) bormi?
        HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS
        YO'Q →  BE GOING TO


JENNINING XATIDA BU QOIDA ANIQ IShLAGAN:

  BE GOING TO (sana YO'Q):
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (sana BOR):
     'We're LEAVING ON 1ST JUNE.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... ON 30TH JUNE.'
     'ON 16TH AUGUST we're HAVING a garden party.'

  BEShTA 'be going to' — hech qaysisida sana yo'q.
  UChTA 'present continuous' — uchalasida ham
  sana bor.
  BITTA ISTISNO ham yo'q.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to visit my grandmother.'
     (Buvimnikiga bormoqchiman — qachonligi
      hali aniq emas.)

  'I'm visiting my grandmother on Sunday.'
     (Yakshanba kuni buvimnikiga boraman —
      kelishilgan.)

RO'YXAT (9 ta mashg'ulot):
  stay at home            (uyda qolmoq)

TOPShIRIQ:
  UChTA ✓ gap  +  UChTA ✗ gap = jami OLTITA


QOLIP:
  ✓  I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
  ✗  I'M NOT GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'I' bilan DOIM 'AM' →
  'I'm going to' / 'I'm not going to'.


NAMUNA JAVOB (oltita gap):

  QILMOQChIMAN (✓):
     I'm going to listen to music and relax.
                                        (NAMUNA)
     I'm going to meet my friends.
     I'm going to study for a test.

  QILMOQChI EMASMAN (✗):
     I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.  (NAMUNA)

  Bu — ro'yxatdagi eng EHTIMOLSIZ ish.

  'STAY AT home'      — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q
  'WATCH TV'          — 'TV' oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'MEET my friends'   — predlogsiz

  'LISTEN TO music'   — predlog TO
  'CLEAN my room'     — predlogsiz

  to study for = ... ga tayyorlanmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Tom's arrangements, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tomning belgilangan ishlariga qarang, so'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOMNING KUNDALIGI:

     SATURDAY 4th JULY
     ─────────────────────────────────────
     10 am:  visit the dentist
     11 am:  meet Frank for coffee
      1 pm:  have lunch with Jane
      5 pm:  catch the train to London


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'What IS Tom DOING at ten o'clock?'
  SB: 'He'S VISITING the dentist at ten o'clock.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan — ya'ni
  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ SOATI bor.

  93-betdagi qoida: aniq vaqt bor →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  'He's GOING TO visit the dentist' bo'lsa —
  shunchaki niyat bo'lardi, kundalikka
  yozilmagan bo'lardi.


QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?
  JAVOB:  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING + at [soat].


BARCHA TO'RT SAVOL-JAVOB:

  1  SA: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock?
     SB: He's visiting the dentist at ten
         o'clock.                      (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: What is Tom doing at eleven o'clock?
     SB: He's meeting Frank for coffee at eleven
         o'clock.

  3  SA: What is Tom doing at one o'clock?
     SB: He's having lunch with Jane at one
         o'clock.

  4  SA: What is Tom doing at five o'clock?
     SB: He's catching the train to London at five
         o'clock.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
  2  Tom soat o'n birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'n birda Frank bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  3  Tom soat birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat birda Jeyn bilan tushlik qiladi.
  4  Tom soat beshda nima qiladi? —
     Soat beshda Londonga poyezdga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — 'VISIT THE DENTIST':
  'visit the dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq.
  'the dentist' — ANIQ artikl bilan
  ('a dentist' emas), chunki bu turg'un ibora.
  Shunday: 'go to the doctor', 'go to the
  dentist'.

DIQQAT — 'CATCH THE TRAIN':
  'catch a train / bus / plane' = poyezdga
  (avtobusga, samolyotga) chiqmoq, ulgurmoq.
  'to catch' = ushlamoq, lekin transport bilan
  'ulgurib chiqmoq' ma'nosida.
  Aksi: 'to MISS the train' (poyezdni boy bermoq).

DIQQAT — 'MEET sb FOR sth':
  'meet Frank FOR coffee' = Frank bilan qahva
  ichgani uchrashmoq.
  'for' bu yerda MAQSADNI bildiradi.

DIQQAT — SOATLARNI O'QISh:
  10 am → 'ten o'clock' (ertalabki 10)
  11 am → 'eleven o'clock'
   1 pm → 'one o'clock' (kunduzgi 1)
   5 pm → 'five o'clock'
  'am' = tushdan oldin, 'pm' = tushdan keyin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an arrangement = belgilangan ish, kelishuv
  a dentist      = tish shifokori
  to catch a train = poyezdga chiqmoq
  am / pm        = tushdan oldin / tushdan keyin

exercises.instructionEn: be going to - present continuous (part 2)
exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous (2-qism)
exercises.explanationUz:
93-BETDAGI QUTINING DAVOMI.

93-betda o'rgangan edik:
  BE GOING TO       →  reja va niyat
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan ish

BU BETDA YANA IKKI VAZIFA:

  • 'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS
     BASED ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'
    = 'be going to' ni HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan
      bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.

  • 'We also use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS for
     ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
     speaking.'
    = 'present continuous' ni HOZIR, gapirayotgan
      paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham
      ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM:

  CHAP RASM — be going to: DALIL
     Odam osmonga qaraydi, osmonda QORA BULUTLAR.
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO RAIN.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor.
      Yomg'ir yog'adi.)
     → Yomg'ir HALI YOG'MAGAN, lekin DALIL bor
       (qora bulutlar) → 'be going to'.

  O'NG RASM — present continuous: HOZIR
     Xuddi shu odam, endi soyabon ostida,
     yomg'ir yog'moqda.
     'IT'S RAINING.'
     (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     → Yomg'ir HOZIR yog'moqda → present
       continuous.


ENDI 'BE GOING TO' NING IKKI VAZIFASI BOR:

  1) REJA va NIYAT (93-bet)
     'I'm going to start a computer course.'
     → o'zim hal qilganman

  2) DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT (94-bet)
     'It's going to rain.'
     → osmonda qora bulutlar bor (KO'RINIB
       TURIBDI)


VA 'PRESENT CONTINUOUS' NING HAM IKKI VAZIFASI:

  1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN kelajak ishi (93-bet)
     'We're leaving on 1st June.'
     → chipta olingan

  2) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan harakat (94-bet)
     'It's raining.'
     → ayni damda


QANDAY AJRATISh — ENG SODDA USUL:

  Harakat HOZIR sodir bo'layaptimi?
     HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ('It's raining')
     YO'Q →  hali bo'lmagan:
              vaqti belgilanganmi?
                 HA   → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                        ('We're leaving on 1st June')
                 YO'Q → BE GOING TO
                        ('It's going to rain')


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:

  'Look at that car! It'S GOING TO crash!'
     (Ana u mashinaga qara! U urilib ketadi!)
     → dalil: mashina nazoratdan chiqqan

  'She's very pale. She'S GOING TO faint.'
     (U juda oqarib ketgan. Hushidan ketadi.)
     → dalil: rangi oqargan

  'The team is playing badly. They'RE GOING TO
   lose.'
     (Jamoa yomon o'ynayapti. Yutqazadi.)
     → dalil: yomon o'yin


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'  → DALIL bor (qora bulut)
  'I think it WILL rain.' → shunchaki FIKR, dalil
                            yo'q
  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin asosi boshqa.

BESh KO'RSATMA:

O'N RASM — HAR KO'RSATMA UChUN IKKITA:

RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

      tomon ketyapti, yonida narvon

   6  He's having a bath.
   7  They're going to play football.
   8  They're playing football.
   9  He's going to paint the house.
  10  He's painting the house.


SAVOL-JAVOBLAR (juftlikda):

   1  SA: What's she going to do?
      SB: She's going to wash the car.
   2  SA: What's she doing?
      SB: She's washing the car.
   3  SA: What's she going to do?
      SB: She's going to drink some orange juice.
   4  SA: What's she doing?
      SB: She's drinking some orange juice.
   5  SA: What's he going to do?
      SB: He's going to have a bath.
   6  SA: What's he doing?
      SB: He's having a bath.
   7  SA: What are they going to do?
      SB: They're going to play football.
   8  SA: What are they doing?
      SB: They're playing football.
   9  SA: What's he going to do?
      SB: He's going to paint the house.
  10  SA: What's he doing?
      SB: He's painting the house.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  U mashinani yuvmoqchi.
   2  U mashinani yuvyapti.
   3  U apelsin sharbati ichmoqchi.
   4  U apelsin sharbati ichyapti.
   5  U vannaga tushmoqchi.
   6  U vannada yotibdi.
   7  Ular futbol o'ynamoqchi.
   8  Ular futbol o'ynashyapti.
   9  U uyni bo'yamoqchi.
  10  U uyni bo'yayapti.


DIQQAT — 'THEY' BILAN 'ARE':
  7 va 8-rasmlarda ega KO'PLIK ('they') →
     'They ARE going to play' → 'They're going
      to play'
     'They ARE playing' → 'They're playing'


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A BATH':
  'have a bath' = vannaga tushmoq, cho'milmoq.
  Britaniya varianti; Amerikada 'take a bath'.
  DIQQAT: 'a bath' — artikl BOR.

DIQQAT — 'PAINT THE HOUSE':
  'to paint' = bo'yamoq (rasm chizmoq ma'nosi
  ham bor).
  Bu yerda uy bo'yash haqida.

DIQQAT — 'SOME ORANGE JUICE':
  'juice' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → 'some' bilan.
  'a juice' odatda aytilmaydi (faqat 'a glass of
  juice').


ENG MUHIM DARS:
  Bir xil harakat IKKI xil shaklda beriladi —
  farq faqat VAQTDA:
     hali boshlanmagan  →  BE GOING TO
     hozir sodir bo'lmoqda →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  • SABABNI 'BECAUSE' bilan, NATIJANI 'SO' bilan
    ifodalaymiz.
  • SABAB yoki MAQSADNI 'TO + fe'l' bilan ham
    ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).


UCh NAMUNA — BIR XIL FIKR, UCh XIL SHAKL:

  1) BECAUSE (sabab):
     'She's going to join a gym BECAUSE she wants
      to lose some weight.'
     (U sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, CHUNKI vazn
      tashlamoqchi.)

  2) SO (natija):
     'She wants to lose some weight, SO she's
      going to join a gym.'
     (U vazn tashlamoqchi, ShUNING UChUN sport
      zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.)

  3) TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'She's going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     (U vazn tashlash UChUN sport zaliga a'zo
      bo'lmoqchi.)


ENG MUHIM — GAP TARTIBI:

  BECAUSE:
     [NATIJA] because [SABAB]
     'join a gym'  ←  'wants to lose weight'
     Ya'ni SABAB 'because' dan KEYIN.

  SO:
     [SABAB], so [NATIJA]
     'wants to lose weight'  →  'join a gym'
     Ya'ni NATIJA 'so' dan KEYIN.

  TARTIB TESKARI! Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joy.


'TO + fe'l' (maqsad infinitivi):
  Eng QISQA shakl.
  Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q:
     'to lose some weight'  ✓
     'to she loses weight'  ✗

  DIQQAT: 'because' dan keyin EGA va FE'L bo'ladi
  ('because SHE WANTS'), 'to' dan keyin esa
  faqat FE'L.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to the shop BECAUSE I need some
   milk.'
  'I need some milk, SO I'm going to the shop.'
  'I'm going to the shop TO BUY some milk.'

  'He studies hard BECAUSE he wants to pass his
   exams.'
  'He wants to pass his exams, SO he studies
   hard.'
  'He studies hard TO PASS his exams.'


DIQQAT — 93-BETDAGI Speaking MAShQI BILAN
BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda 'because' yoki 'to-inf' bilan gaplarni
  birlashtirgan edingiz:
     'She is going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     'She is going to relax BECAUSE she's quite
      tired.'

IKKI USTUN:

  INTENTIONS (niyatlar):
     1  save money            (pul yig'moq)
     2  join a gym            (sport zaliga a'zo
                               bo'lmoq)
     3  stop eating sweets    (shirinlik yeyishni
                               to'xtatmoq)
     4  study hard            (qattiq o'qimoq)
     5  learn English         (ingliz tilini
                               o'rganmoq)

  REASON/PURPOSE (sabab/maqsad):
     a  keep fit              (sog'lom bo'lmoq)
     b  pass his exams        (imtihonlardan
                               o'tmoq)
     c  go on holiday         (ta'tilga bormoq)
     d  lose weight           (vazn tashlamoq)
     e  get a better job      (yaxshiroq ish
                               topmoq)


Kitob BIRINCHISINI chizib bergan: 1 → c


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  save money         →  c  go on holiday
  2  join a gym         →  a  keep fit
  3  stop eating sweets →  d  lose weight
  4  study hard         →  b  pass his exams
  5  learn English      →  e  get a better job


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — MANTIQ:

  1  Nega pul yig'adi? — TA'TILGA borish uchun
     (ta'til pul talab qiladi).

  2  Nega sport zaliga boradi? — SOG'LOM bo'lish
     uchun.
     DIQQAT: 'lose weight' ham mumkindek
     ko'rinadi, lekin u 3-band uchun ajratilgan.

  3  Nega shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatadi? —
     VAZN TAShLASh uchun.
     Shirinlik → vazn ortadi, demak to'xtatish →
     vazn tashlash.

  4  Nega qattiq o'qiydi? — IMTIHONLARDAN O'TISh
     uchun.

  5  Nega ingliz tilini o'rganadi? — YAXShIROQ ISh
     topish uchun.


DIQQAT — 2 va 3-BANDLAR ALDAMChI:
  'join a gym' bilan 'lose weight' ham,
  'keep fit' ham mos keladi.
  LEKIN 'stop eating sweets' faqat 'lose weight'
  bilan mos keladi ('keep fit' bilan emas).
  Shuning uchun:
     3 → d (lose weight)
     2 → a (keep fit)

  Bu — MANTIQIY ISTISNO usuli: avval faqat
  BITTA javobi bor bandni hal qiling.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to keep fit  = sog'lom, formada bo'lmoq
  to pass an exam = imtihondan o'tmoq
     (aksi: 'to FAIL an exam' — yiqilmoq)
  sweets       = shirinliklar
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq

KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun):

  1) 'Tony is going to save money BECAUSE he wants
      to go on holiday.'
  2) 'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going
      to save money.'
  3) 'Tony is going to save money TO GO on
      holiday.'

  Demak HAR BIR band uchun UChTA gap tuziladi!


QOLIPLAR:

  1) BECAUSE:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] BECAUSE he wants to
      [SABAB].'

  2) SO:
     'Tony wants to [SABAB], SO he is going to
      [NIYAT].'

  3) TO + fe'l:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] TO [SABAB].'


BARCHA BESh BAND — UChTADAN GAP:

─── 1  save money / go on holiday ───  (NAMUNA)
  Tony is going to save money because he wants to
  go on holiday.
  Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to
  save money.
  Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.

─── 2  join a gym / keep fit ───
  Tony is going to join a gym because he wants to
  keep fit.
  Tony wants to keep fit, so he is going to join a
  gym.
  Tony is going to join a gym to keep fit.

─── 3  stop eating sweets / lose weight ───
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets because he
  wants to lose weight.
  Tony wants to lose weight, so he is going to
  stop eating sweets.
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets to lose
  weight.

─── 4  study hard / pass his exams ───
  Tony is going to study hard because he wants to
  pass his exams.
  Tony wants to pass his exams, so he is going to
  study hard.
  Tony is going to study hard to pass his exams.

─── 5  learn English / get a better job ───
  Tony is going to learn English because he wants
  to get a better job.
  Tony wants to get a better job, so he is going
  to learn English.
  Tony is going to learn English to get a better
  job.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har banddan bittadan):
  1  Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga
     bormoqchi.
  2  Toni sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, chunki
     sog'lom bo'lmoqchi.
  3  Toni shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatmoqchi, chunki
     vazn tashlamoqchi.
  4  Toni qattiq o'qimoqchi, chunki imtihonlardan
     o'tmoqchi.
  5  Toni ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi, chunki
     yaxshiroq ish topmoqchi.


DIQQAT — 'STOP EATING':
  'stop' dan keyin fe'l '-ING' oladi:
     'stop EATING sweets'  ✓
     'stop to eat sweets'  — boshqa ma'no
       (yeyish uchun to'xtamoq)

DIQQAT — 'SO' DAN OLDIN VERGUL:
  'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going to
   save money.'
  Vergul SHART.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — 'WILL' NING IKKI VAZIFASI:

  We use WILL:

  1) TO MAKE PREDICTIONS (bashorat qilish)
     'In 100 years' time, there WILL BE underwater
      cities.'
     (100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar
      bo'ladi.)
     → Bu shunchaki FIKR, dalil yo'q.

  2) TO MAKE ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS
     (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
     'I'LL HAVE soup first, then steak and chips.'
     (Avval sho'rva, keyin bifshteks va kartoshka
      olaman.)
     → Menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA hal qildi.


KELASI ZAMON BILAN IShLATILADIGAN VAQT IBORALARI:
     tomorrow              (ertaga)
     soon                  (yaqinda)
     next week/month/etc   (keyingi hafta/oy)
     the day after tomorrow (indinga)
     in 100 years' time    (100 yildan keyin)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'WILL' va 'BE GOING TO':

  BASHORATDA:
     'It's GOING TO rain.'
        → DALIL bor (qora bulutlar KO'RINIB
          turibdi)
     'I think it WILL rain.'
        → shunchaki FIKR, dalil YO'Q

  QARORDA:
     'I'M GOING TO join a gym.'
        → OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja
     'I'LL close the window.'
        → AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi
          (sovqotgani uchun)


QANDAY AJRATISh — SODDA USUL:
  Qaror QAChON qabul qilingan?
     ALLAQAChON  →  BE GOING TO
     HOZIRGINA   →  WILL

  Bashorat NIMAGA asoslangan?
     KO'RINIB turgan DALILGA  →  BE GOING TO
     shunchaki FIKRGA         →  WILL


'WILL' NING ShAKLLARI:
  TASDIQ:  ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l
              'I will close the window.'
              → 'I'LL close the window.'
  INKOR:   ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l
              'It won't rain.'
  SO'ROQ:  WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
              'Will it be sunny?'
  QISQA JAVOB:
              'Yes, it will.' / 'No, it won't.'

  DIQQAT: 'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
  ('will to go', 'will goes', 'will going' XATO).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a prediction        = bashorat
  an on-the-spot decision = shu payt qabul
                        qilingan qaror
  underwater          = suv ostidagi
  in 100 years' time  = 100 yildan keyin
  the day after tomorrow = indinga
  steak and chips     = bifshteks va qovurilgan
                        kartoshka

QANDAY AJRATISh — IKKI IP:

  IP 1 — VAQT IBORASI BORMI?

     BAShORAT — oldida KELAJAK VAQTI aytiladi
             ('In 50 years' time', 'tomorrow')


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  2  'IN 50 YEARS' TIME, I THINK there will be

     Ob-havo bashorati → BAShORAT

     Qorni ochdi → ayni damda qaror qildi.
     → QAROR

  5  'IN 100 YEARS' TIME, people will have flying
      cars.'
     Uzoq kelajak haqida → BAShORAT

  'myself' = o'zimga (o'zlik olmoshi).
  'make sb sth' = kimgadir nimadir tayyorlamoq.

  'MORE cars ... THAN people'
  Unit 12 dagi qiyoslash.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — ENG QISQA, LEKIN JUDA MUHIM:

  'IT WILL BE + ADJECTIVE (SIFAT)'
     'It will be RAINY tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi.)

  'THERE WILL BE + NOUN (OT)'
     'There will be RAIN tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?

     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


OB-HAVO JUFTLIKLARI — SIFAT va OT:

     SIFAT          OT
     ─────────────  ─────────────
     rainy          rain
     sunny          sunshine
     foggy          fog
     snowy          snow
     windy          strong winds
     cloudy         clouds
     stormy         a storm

  Har juftlik uchun ikki xil gap tuzish mumkin:
     'IT will be RAINY tomorrow.'    (sifat)
     'THERE will be RAIN tomorrow.'  (ot)
     Ma'no BIR XIL.


10a-MAShQDAGI NAMUNALAR — AYNAN ShU QOIDA:
  'IT will be SUNNY in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunny' — SIFAT → IT)
  'THERE will be SUNSHINE in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunshine' — OT → THERE)


DIQQAT — 'STRONG WINDS' KO'PLIK:
  'THERE WILL BE strong winds.'
  'wind' — sanaladigan ot bo'lishi mumkin;
  ob-havo haqida odatda KO'PLIK: 'strong winds'.

DIQQAT — 'SNOW' va 'SNOWY':
  'snow' — OT (SANALMAYDIGAN) → 'There will be
           SNOW.'
  'snowy' — SIFAT → 'It will be SNOWY.'

QOIDA (yuqoridagi qutidan):

     OT     →  THERE will be


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  2  THERE  will be STRONG WINDS in Harare
            tomorrow.
  3  IT     will be RAINY in Seoul tomorrow.

  3  Ertaga Seulda yomg'irli bo'ladi.
  4  Ertaga Sidneyda quyoshli bo'ladi.
  5  Ertaga Varshavada qor bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'foggy' — SIFAT ('-y' bilan tugaydi) → IT
  2  'strong winds' — OT (ko'plik) → THERE
  3  'rainy' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT
  4  'sunny' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT
  5  'snow' — OT (sanalmaydigan) → THERE


ENG SODDA IP — '-Y' HARFI:
  Ob-havo so'zi '-y' bilan tugasa — SIFAT → IT:
     fogGY, rainY, sunnY, snowY, windY, cloudY
  '-y' siz bo'lsa — OT → THERE:
     fog, rain, sunshine, snow, winds, clouds

  Bu — 5 tadan 5 tasini to'g'ri hal qiladi.


DIQQAT — 2 va 5-BANDLAR:
  Kitob ataylab OTLARNI ishlatgan ('strong winds',
  'snow'), sifat emas — shuning uchun 'THERE'.
  Agar sifat ishlatilganda bo'lardi:
     'IT will be WINDY in Harare tomorrow.'
     'IT will be SNOWY in Warsaw tomorrow.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.


DIQQAT — 10a-MAShQNING JAVOBI ShU YERDA:
  Bu besh gap 10a-mashqdagi besh shaharning
  ob-havosini OChIQ aytadi:
     Dublin — foggy

     Seoul  — rainy
     Sydney — sunny

hal qilish mumkin.

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI HOLAT va YETTI QAROR.

  HOLATLAR (prompts):
     I'm thirsty.          (Chanqadim.)
     It's raining.         (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     It's cold.            (Sovuq.)
     I'm tired.            (Charchadim.)
     I'm hungry.           (Qornim ochdi.)
     It's hot.             (Issiq.)
     The house is on fire. (Uy yonyapti.)

  QARORLAR (on-the-spot decisions):
     close the window       (derazani yopmoq)
     have a sandwich        (buterbrod yemoq)
     have a glass of water  (bir stakan suv ichmoq)
     call the fire brigade  (o't o'chiruvchilarni
                             chaqirmoq)
     go to bed              (yotmoq)
     open the window        (derazani ochmoq)
     put on my raincoat     (plash kiymoq)


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I'm thirsty. I'LL HAVE a glass of water.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  I'm thirsty.          →  have a glass of water
  It's raining.         →  put on my raincoat
  It's cold.            →  close the window
  I'm tired.            →  go to bed
  I'm hungry.           →  have a sandwich
  It's hot.             →  open the window
  The house is on fire. →  call the fire brigade


BARCHA GAPLAR:

  I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
                                       (NAMUNA)
  It's raining. I'll put on my raincoat.
  It's cold. I'll close the window.
  I'm tired. I'll go to bed.
  I'm hungry. I'll have a sandwich.
  It's hot. I'll open the window.
  The house is on fire. I'll call the fire
  brigade.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
  Yomg'ir yog'yapti. Plash kiyaman.
  Sovuq. Derazani yopaman.
  Charchadim. Yotaman.
  Qornim ochdi. Buterbrod yeyman.
  Issiq. Derazani ochaman.
  Uy yonyapti. O't o'chiruvchilarni chaqiraman.


QOLIP:
  [HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.

  Birinchi qism — HOZIRGI holat (sabab).
  Ikkinchi qism — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.

  Bu — 9-mashqning 1 va 4-bandlari bilan
  BIR XIL naqsh:
     'I'm cold. I'll close the window.'
     'I'm hungry. I'll make myself a sandwich.'


DIQQAT — IKKI ALDAMChI JUFTLIK:

  'It's COLD' → CLOSE the window
  'It's HOT'  → OPEN the window

  Ikkalasi ham deraza haqida, lekin TESKARI
  harakat. Diqqat bilan o'qing.


DIQQAT — 'PUT ON':
  'put on' = kiymoq.
  'put ON my raincoat' — ikki so'zli fe'l.
  Aksi: 'take off' (yechmoq).

DIQQAT — 'THE FIRE BRIGADE':
  'the fire brigade' = o't o'chirish xizmati
  (Britaniya varianti).
  Amerikada: 'the fire department'.
  'on fire' = yonmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  thirsty      = chanqagan
  a raincoat   = plash, yomg'irpo'sh
  a fire brigade = o't o'chirish xizmati
  on fire      = yonmoqda
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI JADVAL:

─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 JADVAL 1 — PLANS/INTENTIONS + REASON/PURPOSE
            (rejalar/niyatlar + sabab/maqsad)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  they/stay at ...  A HOTEL
     they both love ...  SWIMMING       (namuna)

  she/relax ...  AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE
     she's quite ...  TIRED (after working hard
                            all this year)

  she/work ...  AT A CAFE
     earn ...  SOME EXTRA MONEY (and buy a new car)

  she/join ...  A GYM
     lose ...  SOME WEIGHT

  she/start ...  A COMPUTER COURSE
     find ...  A BETTER JOB (in autumn)


─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 JADVAL 2 — FIXED ARRANGEMENTS
            (qat'iy belgilangan ishlar)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  they/leave on ...  1ST JUNE

  they/come back ...  FROM THEIR HOLIDAYS
     on ...  30TH JUNE

  they/have a ...  GARDEN PARTY
     on ...  16TH AUGUST
     to ...  CELEBRATE RICHARD'S BIRTHDAY


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They ARE GOING TO stay at a hotel next to the
   beach BECAUSE they both love swimming.'


IKKI XIL BOG'LOVChI — QAChON QAYSI BIRI:

  BECAUSE  →  SABAB (nega?)
     'because they both love swimming'
     'because she's quite tired'
     Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bo'ladi.

  TO + fe'l  →  MAQSAD (nima uchun?)
     'to earn some extra money'
     'to lose some weight'
     'to find a better job'
     Ergash gapda ega YO'Q.


DIQQAT — JADVALDAGI IP:
  Jadvalning o'ng ustunida FE'L berilgan bo'lsa
  ('earn', 'lose', 'find') → 'TO + fe'l' ishlating.
  Sifat yoki gap berilgan bo'lsa
  ('they both love ...', 'she's quite ...') →
  'BECAUSE' ishlating.


BARCHA GAPLAR — PLANS/INTENTIONS (be going to):

  1  They are going to stay at a hotel next to the
     beach BECAUSE they both love swimming.
                                        (NAMUNA)

  2  She is going to relax as much as possible
     BECAUSE she's quite tired.

  3  She is going to work at a cafe TO EARN some
     extra money.

  4  She is going to join a gym TO LOSE some
     weight.

  5  She is going to start a computer course TO
     FIND a better job.


BARCHA GAPLAR — FIXED ARRANGEMENTS
(present continuous):

  6  They are leaving on 1st June.

  7  They are coming back from their holidays on
     30th June.

  8  They are having a garden party on 16th August
     TO CELEBRATE Richard's birthday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Ular plyaj yonidagi mehmonxonada turmoqchi,
     chunki ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
  2  U imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchi, chunki
     ancha charchagan.
  3  U qo'shimcha pul topish uchun kafeda
     ishlamoqchi.
  4  U vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo
     bo'lmoqchi.
  5  U yaxshiroq ish topish uchun kompyuter
     kursini boshlamoqchi.
  6  Ular 1-iyunda jo'naydilar.
  7  Ular 30-iyunda ta'tildan qaytadilar.
  8  Ular 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini
     nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladilar.


ENG MUHIM — IKKI JADVAL IKKI GRAMMATIKA:
  1-jadval (PLANS/INTENTIONS) → BE GOING TO
  2-jadval (FIXED ARRANGEMENTS) → PRESENT
                                   CONTINUOUS
  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining
  amaliy mashqi.

SAVOL-JAVOB QOLIPI:

  SA: 'What's your star sign?'
      (Burjing qaysi?)
  SB: 'I'm (a) Leo.' / 'My star sign is Leo.'
      (Men Arslonman.)
  SA: 'When were you born?'
      (Qachon tug'ilgansan?)

  So'ng bashoratni aytasiz:
  SA: 'You'll get some good news in a letter, and
       you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.'


BURJNI ANIQLASh QOLIPI:
  'If you were born between [sana] and [sana],
   you're (a) [burj].'
  Masalan:
  'If you were born between 23rd July and 23rd
   August, you're a Leo.'


NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: What's your star sign?
  SB: I'm a Capricorn.
  SA: Really? Then this won't be a good week for
      you. You'll have problems with your health.
      Try to relax!
  SB: Oh no! What about you? What's your star
      sign?
  SA: I'm an Aquarius.
  SB: Lucky you! This will be your lucky week.
      You'll get a lot of money and you'll get an
      invitation at the weekend. Accept it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Burjing qaysi?
  SB: Men Echkiman.
  SA: Rostdanmi? Unda bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta
      bo'lmaydi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi.
      Dam olishga harakat qil!
  SB: Voy! Sen-chi? Sening burjing qaysi?
  SA: Men Qovgaman.
  SB: Omading bor ekan! Bu sening omadli hafting
      bo'ladi. Ko'p pul olasan va dam olish
      kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil!


DIQQAT — ARTIKL:
  'I'm A Leo.' / 'I'm AN Aquarius.'
  Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — 'an':
     an Aquarius, an Aries
  Undosh bilan — 'a':
     a Leo, a Capricorn, a Taurus

  Artiklsiz ham aytish mumkin:
  'My star sign is Leo.'


FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  What's your star sign?  = Burjing qaysi?
  When were you born?     = Qachon tug'ilgansan?
  Lucky you!              = Omading bor ekan!
  Oh no!                  = Voy!
  Really?                 = Rostdanmi?

      A: No, he isn't. He's going to paint the
         house.

exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib keyingi haftalik bashoratlarni yozing. Loyihangizni burj rasmlari bilan bezating.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu loyiha kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi ma'lumotga tayanadi — bizdagi
  skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida SHU BETDAGI 12 bashorat
  asosida tuzilgan QOLIPLAR va NAMUNA berilgan.
  Bu qoliplar bilan istalgan bashoratni yozish
  mumkin.


BAShORAT YOZISh — TUZILISh:

  1) BURJ NOMI va SANALARI
     'Leo (July 23 - Aug. 23)'

  2) HAFTANING UMUMIY TA'RIFI
     'This will be a(n) [SIFAT] week.'
     yoki
     'It will be a [SIFAT] week for you.'

  3) IKKI-UCh BAShORAT
     'You'll [fe'l] ...'

  4) MASLAHAT (buyruq gap)
     'Accept it.' / 'Don't worry.' /
     'Try to relax.' / 'Enjoy yourself.'


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN SIFATLAR:
  IJOBIY:  exciting, pleasant, lucky, wonderful,
           great, fantastic
  SALBIY:  difficult, bad, horrible, terrible


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN BAShORATLAR:
  You'll receive a letter from a friend.
  You'll get an invitation.
  You'll go on a long journey / a short trip.
  You'll meet an interesting person.
  You'll get some good news.
  You'll get a lot of money.
  You'll lose some money.
  You'll argue with your best friend.
  You'll have problems with your health.
  You'll have problems with someone in your
  family.
  You'll have a lot of fun.


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN MASLAHATLAR:
  Accept it.          (Qabul qil.)
  Don't accept it.    (Qabul qilma.)
  Don't worry.        (Xavotir olma.)
  Try to relax.       (Dam olishga harakat qil.)
  Try to rest.        (Dam ol.)
  Enjoy yourself.     (Zavqlan.)
  Don't drive too fast. (Tez haydama.)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA (o'zingiz yozganingizda
shu qolipdan foydalaning):

  ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)
  This will be a wonderful week. You'll get some
  good news on Monday and you'll meet an
  interesting person at the weekend. Enjoy
  yourself!

  TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21)
  This won't be an easy week. You'll argue with
  someone at school, but don't worry — everything
  will be okay soon.

  GEMINI (May 22 - June 21)
  It will be a lucky week for you. You'll receive
  an invitation to a party on Friday. Accept it!

  CANCER (June 22 - July 22)
  This will be a busy week. There will be a lot of
  work, but you'll have a lot of fun at the
  weekend.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  QO'Y (21-mart — 19-aprel)
  Bu ajoyib hafta bo'ladi. Dushanba kuni yaxshi
  yangilik olasan va dam olish kunlari qiziqarli
  odam bilan uchrashasan. Zavqlan!

  BUZOQ (20-aprel — 21-may)
  Bu oson hafta bo'lmaydi. Maktabda kimdir bilan
  janjallashasan, lekin xavotir olma — tez orada
  hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

  EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun)
  Bu sen uchun omadli hafta bo'ladi. Juma kuni
  ziyofatga taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil!

  QISQIChBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul)
  Bu band hafta bo'ladi. Ish ko'p bo'ladi, lekin
  dam olish kunlari juda ko'ngilli vaqt
  o'tkazasan.


GRAMMATIK QOIDALAR — ESLATMA:

  1) HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan
     (95-bet: bashorat uchun 'will').

  2) 'IT will be + SIFAT' / 'THERE will be + OT'
     'It will be a lucky week.' (sifat: lucky)
     'There will be a lot of work.' (ot: work)

  3) 'You'll' = 'You will' (qisqargan shakl).

  4) INKOR: 'This WON'T be ...' (= will not).

  5) MASLAHAT — BUYRUQ gap:
     tasdiq: 'Accept it.' 'Enjoy yourself.'
     inkor:  'Don't worry.' 'Don't accept it.'


BEZASH:
  Kitob har bir burjning RASMINI chizishni
  so'raydi. Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang:
  buqa (Taurus), egizaklar (Gemini),
  qisqichbaqa (Cancer), arslon (Leo),
  tarozi (Libra), chayon (Scorpio),
  baliqlar (Pisces), qo'y (Aries) va h.k.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny is going to stay at a fabulous hotel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'BE GOING TO' — oldindan o'ylangan REJA va NIYAT.
'going to' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + ISN'T/AREN'T + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny isn't going to sunbathe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni quyoshda toblanmoqchi emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
INKOR: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN qo'yiladi.
'is not going to' → 'isn't going to'.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + ON + sana.   (aniq reja)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny is having a party on 16th August.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni 16-avgustda ziyofat qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ SANAGA belgilangan
kelajak rejasi.
SANA bilan 'ON' predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where is X going to spend her holiday?  —  She is going to spend it in ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is Jenny going to spend her summer holiday?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savoldagi zamon javobda SAQLANADI.
'spend a holiday' = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: START + fe'l-ING   /   START + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: start windsurfing / start French lessons / start a computer course
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: vindserfingni boshlamoq / fransuz tili darslarini boshlamoq / kompyuter kursini boshlamoq
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'start' dan keyin FE'L kelsa — '-ING' oladi.
OT kelsa — o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE (NOT) + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to listen to music and relax. I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Musiqa tinglab dam olmoqchiman. Nyu-Delhiga uchmoqchi emasman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
REJA va NIYAT.
'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN.
'do/does' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: AM/IS/ARE + ega + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l?  —  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you going to move house? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoqchimisan? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'be' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'going to' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + [ANIQ VAQT].   (qat'iy belgilangan)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We're leaving on 1st June. I'm flying to Poland at 7 o'clock.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz. Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ VAQT bo'lganda.
Chipta olingan, sana kelishilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is going to + fe'l + BECAUSE + [ega + fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are going to stay at a hotel because they both love swimming.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular mehmonxonada turmoqchi, chunki ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is going to + fe'l + TO + ASOSIY fe'l.   (MAQSAD)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is going to join a gym to lose some weight.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('nima uchun?').
Ergash gapda ega YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?  —  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING at [soat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock? — He's visiting the dentist at ten o'clock.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? — Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ SOATI bor ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

sentencePatterns.formula: [DALIL]. ega + is/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
Avval dalil, keyin bashorat.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's she GOING TO do?  ↔  What's she DOING?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's she going to do? — She's going to wash the car. / What's she doing? — She's washing the car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U nima qilmoqchi? — Mashinani yuvmoqchi. / U nima qilyapti? — Mashinani yuvyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Harakat hali boshlanmagan → 'going to'.
Hozir sodir bo'lmoqda → present continuous.
SAVOL ham shunga qarab o'zgaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is she + fe'l-ING ?  —  No, she isn't. She's GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is she washing the car? — No, she isn't. She's going to wash the car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mashinani yuvyaptimi? — Yo'q. U mashinani yuvmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qisqa javob + TUZATISH.
'be' fe'li bilan — 'do' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: A BECAUSE B.  /  B, SO A.  /  A TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony is going to save money because he wants to go on holiday. / Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to save money. / Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. / Toni ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. / Toni ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir fikrni UCH xil aytish.
'because' va 'so' da TARTIB TESKARI.
'to + fe'l' — eng qisqa shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: [HOZIRGI HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.   (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm cold. I'll close the window. I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman. Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval HOLAT (sabab), keyin QAROR.
Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan.

sentencePatterns.formula: In [vaqt], there WILL BE + ot.   (bashorat)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In 100 years' time, there will be underwater cities.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Uzoq kelajak haqidagi BASHORAT.
Dalil yo'q — shunchaki fikr.

sentencePatterns.formula: IT will be + SIFAT.   /   THERE will be + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be rainy tomorrow. There will be rain tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi. Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT → IT, OT → THERE.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.
ENG SODDA IP: '-y' bilan tugasa — sifat.

sentencePatterns.formula: WILL IT BE + sifat + in [joy] tomorrow?  —  Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will it be sunny in Bangkok tomorrow? — Yes, it will.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga Bangkokda quyoshli bo'ladimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'WILL' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'be' TAKRORLANMAYDI.
'won't' = 'will not'.

sentencePatterns.formula: This WILL BE a(n) [sifat] week.   /   This WON'T BE a good week.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This will be an exciting week. This won't be a good week for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu qiziqarli hafta bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bashoratning ochilish gapi.
'won't' = 'will not'.
Unli tovushdan oldin 'an'.

sentencePatterns.formula: You'LL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... + ON [kun] / AT the weekend.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You'll receive a letter from a friend. You'll get an invitation at the weekend.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'stingdan xat olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'You'll' = 'You will'.
KUN bilan 'ON', 'weekend' bilan 'AT'.

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   IT WILL BE + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There will be bad news on Wednesday. It will be a pleasant week for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
95-betdagi qoida bashoratlarda ISTISNOSIZ
ishlaydi: OT → THERE, SIFAT → IT.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Salbiy bashorat]. DON'T WORRY — everything will be okay soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You'll argue with your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be friends again.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Salbiy bashoratdan keyin DOIM TASALLI beriladi.
Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius va Pisces
bashoratlarida shunday.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your star sign?  —  I'm a/an [burj].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your star sign? — I'm an Aquarius.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Burjing qaysi? — Men Qovgaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — 'an'
(an Aquarius, an Aries).
Undosh bilan — 'a' (a Leo, a Taurus).
